paragraphs.text: On the Costa del Sol, in the grounds of Finca Cortesin, the first Lanserhof in southern Europe is taking shape. Mediterranean light, sea and mountains meet Lanserhof medicine here – from 2027.
paragraphs.fontFamily: "Neue Frutiger World", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"

paragraphs.text: Light, sea and moments of calm – photographed by Patrick Graf.
paragraphs.fontFamily: "Neue Frutiger World", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"

paragraphs.text: On the grounds of Finca Cortesin, a house with 71 rooms and suites, 2,900 m² of medicine and a spa and movement area of the highest standard is taking shape.
paragraphs.fontFamily: "Neue Frutiger World", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"

paragraphs.text: From north to south: after Sylt, the next Lanserhof is taking shape on the Costa del Sol – 71 rooms and suites, 2,900 m² of medicine and a spa and movement area of the highest standard.
paragraphs.fontFamily: "Neue Frutiger World", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"

paragraphs.text: 1.5 km from the beach, Marbella, Puerto Banús and Sotogrande close by, Málaga airport 50 minutes away by car.
paragraphs.fontFamily: "Neue Frutiger World", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"

paragraphs.text: The resort is taking shape in one of the most tranquil regions of the Andalusian coast. Marbella, Puerto Banús and Sotogrande are all close by.
paragraphs.fontFamily: "Neue Frutiger World", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"

paragraphs.text: Responsibility, a learning culture, appreciation and loyalty – lived at every location.
paragraphs.fontFamily: "Neue Frutiger World", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"

Welcome to
MARBELLA

On the Costa del Sol, in the grounds of Finca Cortesin, the first Lanserhof in southern Europe is taking shape. Mediterranean light, sea and mountains meet Lanserhof medicine here – from 2027.

Impressions of
LANSERHOF MARBELLA

Light, sea and moments of calm – photographed by Patrick Graf.

Andalusia, from 2027
FIRST IN THE SOUTH

On the grounds of Finca Cortesin, a house with 71 rooms and suites, 2,900 m² of medicine and a spa and movement area of the highest standard is taking shape.

From north to south: after Sylt, the next Lanserhof is taking shape on the Costa del Sol – 71 rooms and suites, 2,900 m² of medicine and a spa and movement area of the highest standard.

Insights into the construction
Casares and the sea
THE QUIETEST SETTING

1.5 km from the beach, Marbella, Puerto Banús and Sotogrande close by, Málaga airport 50 minutes away by car.

The resort is taking shape in one of the most tranquil regions of the Andalusian coast. Marbella, Puerto Banús and Sotogrande are all close by.
